entries.description: Re-grounded Layer A against current tree: aggregator call Pipeline.cs:655 feeds functionClassifications only (body-only); FunctionClassificationBuilder.ClassificationVisitor.Visit walks procedureAst.Body only by design (FunctionClassificationBuilder.cs:177-187) → header unresolved refs dropped; resolvedModule.References DOES carry the header ref (projector GroupReferencesByProcedure groups by enclosing ProcedureScope incl. header → Body.References). DESIGN DECIDED (s1-design-note.md): dedup-additive feed — keep FunctionClassification feed unchanged, additionally feed procedure-scoped resolver Unresolved references deduped by module+procedure+line+column+reason; net-new = header refs only (zero on HHC → provably golden-neutral). Red pin encoded (LayerA_HeaderUnresolvedRef_DroppedByBodyOnlyFeed_RecoveredByProcedureScopedFeed): empirically confirms the header ref IS inline on Body.References and ABSENT from the body-only aggregation — the gap is real, not assumed.

Layer A dedup-additive feed: new ParserOutputProjector.EnumerateProcedureScopedReferences (returns the SAME set the projector groups into Body.References) + UnresolvedItemAggregator.FromProcedureScopedReferences + ProcedureScopedReference record + a procedureScopedReferences param on Build; Pipeline.cs (one call site) builds the feed from resolvedModules and passes it. Net-new = header refs; header items tagged Source=FunctionClassification, fields mirror the body-ref shape exactly.

5 hermetic pins in UnresolvedItemsCompletenessTests: header reaches index; body ref emitted exactly once (no-double-count) + additive feed inert on header-free module (bodyOnly.Count==withHeaders.Count); index is structural superset of inline Body.References[Unresolved]; header index position aligns with inline; chained-header all-links-reach-index (the gpt-5-4 R1 pin). Full Pipeline.Tests 912/912 green.

Golden assessed and proven byte-level NEUTRAL on HHC (no regen): CanonicalGoldenRegressionTests.HomeHealthCare_ReproducesGoldenOutput reproduces unresolved-items.json + manifest + kb + ir + reports-baseline byte-identical (foreground COM, TRX-confirmed), run twice — once after the initial impl and again after the R1 dedup-key fix. HHC has zero header/module-level unresolved cases (DW-11). Swept the samples/*.accdb timestamp churn.

Routed cross-provider session-verification (gpt-5-4, focus on the dedup seam per the design note): R1 ISSUES_FOUND with 1 Major — bodyKeys.Add(...) dedup'd the procedure-scoped feed against itself, dropping a distinct chained-header link (Foo.Bar vs Foo.Bar.Baz share the 5-tuple key). DEMONSTRATED real (pin red pre-fix) and FIXED: non-mutating Contains (dedup only vs the body-only snapshot) + SurroundingText added to the key. R2 VERIFIED (empty issues). s1-issues.json + s1-devils-advocate-prompt.md authored.

Re-grounded Layer B: ParserOutputProjector.GroupReferencesByProcedure still drops module-level refs (no ProcedureScope); empirically confirmed via probe that `Public Const DemoConst = MissingThing` yields one ResolvedModule.References entry (enclosingScope=ModuleScope, outcome=Unresolved). Encoded 3 Layer B pins (red-evidence: dropped from inline Body.References AND post-S1 index).

Schema decision recorded (s2-design-note.md): manifest home = run-wide index; new UnresolvedSource.ModuleLevelReference (ProcedureName=null); widen the living v1.1 Source enum only (no envelope bump, no ParserOutput change). Routed architecture critique (opus) SOUND-WITH-CAVEATS.
Implemented EnumerateModuleLevelReferences + FromModuleLevelReferences + ModuleLevelReference record + enum value + schema widening + Pipeline.cs wiring. No double-count (disjoint by scope).

Golden-affecting: gate caught 2 real HHC module-level refs (vbObjectError in basDataOperations Const decls). HHC regenerated; proven multiset delta exactly +2 ModuleLevelReference items, 0 removed (count 1414->1416). Determinism hardening: injective CanonicalResidual final tiebreaker (the key was not a total order). Pipeline.Tests 922/922; golden+schema conformance 7/7 byte-identical.

Routed cross-provider session-verification (gpt-5-4): R1 ISSUES (Major non-total comparer) -> R2 ISSUES (Major non-injective residual + Minor) -> R3 ISSUES (Minor pin breadth) -> R4 VERIFIED. In-IDE devil's-advocate prompt authored.
Routed next-set recommendation (gemini-pro): consumer-driven-only handoff (DW-1..8, DW-14 bundling candidates). DW-11 discharged; new DW-17 (per-module ParserOutput asymmetry).
